fusions.name: Somebody Else's Stink
fusions.desc: Flicks a dab of your musk onto an enemy up to 8 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at maximum range. It always crits and leaves the target [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Counted Your Coins
fusions.desc: Looses 3 jets of musk in a spread out to 6 tiles. Each jet deals 5 damage, and 20% of the damage dealt comes back to you as healing over the following 6 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Rolled in It
fusions.desc: Masks your own scent under musk for 7 seconds. Enemies notice you 60% later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Can't See for Crying
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 12%.
